name: F7 navigation and cross-probe
description: Definition-of-done slice F7 (audit S11, S12, S13, the S24 sheet-picker drift) on an isolated fixture project. In the Pages tab, Add sheet adds Sheet 2 and a resistor is placed on it with real X input; back on Sheet 1, Design > Run ERC reports the resistor's unconnected pins, and a click on a finding opens the Sheet 2 document tab (sch:<id>, not the first schematic) with the resistor selected (S12). Back on Sheet 1, Quick open of the resistor's designator opens Sheet 2 and selects it there (S11). Quick open of a net, Design manager wire and label selection (S13), no-connect / bus / bus-entry references (positions, or disabled with a reason) and the header sheet picker opening sch:<id> (S24) are covered by vitest (src/navigation.f7.test.tsx): the sheet picker is a native <select>, whose popup this harness cannot drive with XTest.

steps.title: Pages tab: Add sheet adds Sheet 2
Open Sheet 2 from the Pages tab
Quick open (Ctrl+P) to arm the Place tool with a part
Enter arms the schematic Place tool
XTest click on Sheet 2 places the resistor there
Escape back to the Select tool
Back to Sheet 1 from the Pages tab
Design > Run ERC reports the resistor's unconnected pins
S12: a click on the ERC finding opens the Sheet 2 document, where the resistor is, not the first sheet
S12: the resistor is selected on Sheet 2
Back to Sheet 1 from the Pages tab
S11: Enter on the symbol opens Sheet 2 (it no longer only selects behind Sheet 1)
S11: the status line says the resistor was selected and zoomed in the schematic
